svg.aria-label: Port one of four on the link bus: ayush-yadav.com, the portfolio, wearing the Waymark. The three page buses run whole through the row — every port taps off its own lane, and no lane leaves the bundle.
svg.title: the link bus, port one — ayush-yadav.com, phone cut
